{{Top|leg}}
'''Bairon''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[InterStellar Regulators]] who served during the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]]. Bairon was stationed at the [[Giant's Spear]] mesa, and Bairon was reprimanded by the captain's superiors when Bairon questioned whether [[Toborro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] would want to keep copies of the plans for [[the Ark]].
